audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..6].side are flat 'Skill' while content win[2..6] already say 'Zyra', matching win[0..1] and packet.levelChart (all seven rows Zyra).
audit.why: win[], whys[] and spikes[] all already describe Zyra holding the lane and the poke war through every stage, including 2+ items; side rows 2-6 were left on the placeholder.

spikes[] already states a real curve: root-plant poke takes over at 2, Stranglethorns wins the ult trade at 6, item parity narrows but doesn't flip the poke war, late still hers unless you flank the plants.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions is empty, but the enemy kit shows both Q (Deadly Spines) and E (Grasping Roots) carry 'grounding' — they shut off enemy dashes — and that was never stated anywhere on the page. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were also verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and breakdown.cooldowns had no real number.
audit.why: A dash-reliant ADC (or a flanking play) walking into her zone gets grounded mid-dash, which changes how the team should engage/disengage through her garden.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d rewritten to state the grounding effect; dosFull[1].d rewritten to match its own title with E's real 11s cooldown timing; breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with that same number.

edits.after: E has two charges — pre-shield before her E root lands (11s cooldown), then bank the second for the all-in after her seeds pop.
